Academic Development Cell
The Academic Development Cell of PDUGMC is dedicated to fostering an enriching and supportive academic environment for our students and faculty members. Our aim is to enhance the overall learning experience and promote academic excellence throughout the college community.
Our key initiatives include:
Faculty Development Programs.
Curriculum Enhancement.
Academic Support Services.
Research Promotion.
Academic Events and Conferences.
We invite you to explore the Academic Development Cell and take advantage of the resources and opportunities available to you. Feel free to reach out to us with any queries or suggestions you may have. Together, let’s embark on an inspiring academic journey!
